However weak schemabinding can be enabled via the GUC 'babelfishpg_tsql.weak_view_binding'. When this GUC is ON views created without SCHEMABINDING clause will have weak schemabinding while views explicitly created WITH SCHEMABINDING maintain strong binding regardless of the GUC setting.
